notes.text: Enron Americas Office of the Chairman announced that the approval threshold for employee meetings and events was lowered to $500. The $5,000 threshold remains for customer events.

Per the Enron Americas Office of the Chairman memo, customer events over $5,000 and employee events over $500 must be reviewed by EA Public Relations and approved by the EA Office of the Chairman before any commitments are made to customers or vendors.

Per the EA memo, the PR department handles site search and hotel contract negotiations for such events. A completed expenditure request form with supporting documentation is required, plus a detailed agenda for employee meetings, submitted to PR at EB 3642.
Dorie Hitchcock in the Enron Americas PR department, (713) 853-6978, is the contact for event approval questions, event planning help and Houston event tickets.
